description: Validates tasks have been derived from requirements and goals

checks.description: Both task breakdown files and the tracking document's folder must exist
checks.remediation: Run plan-derivetasks on requirements.json and goals.json

checks.description: Every task must have an ID, title, acceptance criteria, and source requirements
checks.remediation: Give each task testable acceptance criteria and the requirement IDs it covers

checks.description: There must be one task file per task
Task files must follow the project's task template
checks.remediation: Use tasks/task-template.md: Task ID, Phase, Priority, Estimated Effort, Status fields and an Acceptance Criteria section

checks.description: A plausible number of tasks should be derived
checks.remediation: Very few or very many tasks may indicate a sizing problem (aim for half a day to ten days each)
